name: Apprenticeship — DELETE Then Re-POST Same Course, Next AY
description: Commitments approves an apprenticeship (standard 21) entirely within AY 25/26 (StartDate 2025-09-01, EndDate 2026-07-31). SLD/Provider then DELETEs the learner scoped to AY 25/26. Provider then POSTs the same learner onto the same course (standard 21) via the new-style route with academicYear=2627, all dates entirely within AY 26/27 (StartDate 2026-09-01, ExpectedEndDate 2027-07-31). Exercises the interaction between DELETE's academic-year scoping and CreateDraftApprenticeshipLearningCommandHandler.Handle's GetAllByLearnerKey(learner.Key, ukprn, courseCode) lookup: since the AY 25/26 row is removed, and the new POST's dates fall in a different AY, a second, independent ApprenticeshipLearning row should be created for the same learner/course/provider rather than the POST being treated as an update of (or blocked by) the removed row.

steps.name: Commitments Approves an Apprenticeship, Standard 21, Entirely Within AY 25/26
SLD Removes the Apprenticeship, Scoped to AY 25/26
Wait — inspect DB after deletion, then continue with re-POST
Provider Re-POSTs the Same Learner Onto the Same Course, Standard 21, Entirely Within AY 26/27

assertions.name: The AY 25/26 episode remains approved but is now removed
A new, independent unapproved draft exists for AY 26/27
Two separate ApprenticeshipLearning rows exist for the learner
